target.body:
## Summary
- add read-only MessageStore stats aggregation for messages by chat, handle, service, and day
- add optional media attachment totals grouped by UTI/MIME and chat
- expose stats via `imsg stats`, `server.getMessageStats`, `getMediaStatistics`, and `getMediaStatisticsByChat`
- exclude tapback/reaction rows from message and media stats with schema-aware filtering
- document the CLI/RPC surface and update the imsg skill; keep release-note text out of the release-owned changelog

## Verification
- `make build` ✅
- release binary smoke test against a temporary SQLite fixture ✅
- before/after proof on lobster ✅
- CI macOS lint failure addressed by moving stats RPC handlers out of `RPCServer+Handlers.swift` (`608` → `580` lines) ✅
- ClawSweeper reaction-count finding addressed by filtering `associated_message_type` tapback rows and adding a tapback fixture regression ✅
- `make test` ⚠️ blocked before project tests run locally: SwiftPM cannot import the repo-wide `Testing` module (`no such module 'Testing'`) with Apple Swift 6.3.1 on this host
- `make lint` ⚠️ on lobster: `swift format lint` completed, then local `swiftlint` crashed loading `sourcekitdInProc.framework`; CI uses SwiftLint successfully and is the source of truth for lint

## Proof

```text

branch_head=7bb20b327e3552d72c626e1f0affd5e56af99d6d
before_stats_exit=1
before_completion_search_exit=1
after_quick_check=ok
after_total_messages=789
after_chat_total_messages=574
after_media_total_attachments=22
after_media_total_bytes=35095987
rpc_methods_ok=3
make_build_main=passed
make_build_branch=passed
make_lint_local=blocked_sourcekitdInProc_on_lobster
ci_macos_lint_fix=split_RPCServer+Handlers_608_to_580_lines
reaction_filter_fix=filters_associated_message_type_2000_3006_from_stats
changelog_edit=removed
make_test=blocked_no_such_module_Testing
```

Raw proof logs are stored locally under `/Users/lobster/imsg-pr-proofs/2026-07-08/161-message-stats/`. They are not pasted here because they include local chat identifiers/handles from lobster's Messages database.
